workload.spsc_counting_unit: distinct acknowledged publication ids; duplicate reads do not increment progress
workload.spsc_ready_ordering: reader initial miss, then reader_ready release-store; writer acquire-load before first publication
workload.spsc_ack_ordering: reader release-stores publication id; writer acquire-loads before publishing the next id
workload.counter_design: per-participant thread-local non-atomic 64-bit records; owner-only writes; aggregate after join; no shared counter operations in the hot loop

windows_plain.role: readiness only; not a TSan substitute

participant_coverage.spsc_duplicate_reads: recorded separately and never counted as distinct progress

result_dimensions.rule: A real correctness/liveness FAIL from plain or sanitized execution is retained regardless of TSan calibration; it is not automatically attributed to production

PASS: all frozen-input and before/after verifiers pass
both compiler lanes have calibrated negative controls and clean smokes
directed initialization/safety and bounded SPSC pass
all 10 Linux TSan protocol processes are clean
every concurrent participant meets the frozen coverage requirement
FAIL: accepted tuple or depth violates writer encoding
decoded concurrent writer id is outside 0..7 or iteration is outside 1..100000
after reader-ready, SPSC observes a wrong/future tuple, fails to acknowledge all 256 distinct publications, deadlocks or times out
plain execution detects a correctness/liveness failure, regardless of TSan calibration
TSan reports a race in a calibrated protocol lane
assertion or unexpected exit from an executing protocol
r5 source fails to compile on an otherwise supported toolchain
INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE: concurrent stress only: no safety violation but one or more writers have zero successful publications
concurrent stress only: no safety violation but one or more readers have zero accepted reads
NOT_RUN: pthread smoke fails before the tested body
known-racy negative control does not emit a genuine TSan data-race report
SPSC cannot reach reader-ready because compile, launch or thread-creation infrastructure failed

fixed_run_completion_policy.on_process_fail_or_incomplete_coverage: record it and continue every remaining predeclared fresh process slot; no replacement or retry
fixed_run_completion_policy.on_shared_input_or_runtime_blocker: stop unsafe/impossible execution and emit a NOT_RUN entry with the reason for every remaining predeclared slot
fixed_run_completion_policy.denominator_rule: no planned slot may disappear from the aggregate result

gate_effect: Only overall PASS can satisfy the G2 publication-race clause; it does not promote the Lazy SMP candidate or close other gates
